title: Flat coefficient push comparison from a bounded filtered module presentation
statement:
Fix the prime, field and separated finite-type scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let $a:R\to S$ be a map of commutative condensed rings for which scalar extension is exact on every scheme. Write $T_Z=S_Z\otimes^L_{R_Z}-$, $U_Z$ for restriction, and $\gamma_f:T_YRf_{R*}\to Rf_{S*}T_X$ for [def-sfb-derived-push-hom]. Work in the ordinary unbounded derived module-object categories, identified with ring-sheaf module categories by [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison].
Let $I$ be a small nonempty filtered category and $(P_i)$ a diagram of flat $R_Y$-modules, with $f_R^*P_i$ flat, and an $R_Y$-linear colimit cocone $v_i:P_i\to U_YS_Y$. Let $K\in D^+(\operatorname{Mod}_{R_X})$. For each $i$ let
$$\delta_i:Rf_{R*}K\otimes^L_{R_Y}P_i\longrightarrow Rf_{R*}(K\otimes^L_{R_X}f_R^*P_i)$$
be the canonical projection map, namely the adjunct of the pullback tensor comparison followed by $\varepsilon_K\otimes1$. If every $\delta_i$ is invertible, then $\gamma_{f,K}$ is invertible. More precisely, using tensor symmetry, restriction and $U_YRf_{S*}\cong Rf_{R*}U_X$, its composite with the cocone leg $1\otimes v_i$ equals $Rf_{R*}(1\otimes f_R^*v_i)\circ\delta_i$, using $f_R^*U_YS_Y\cong U_XS_X$.
